tutorial.title: Welcome to WordDaily!
tutorial.subtitle: Learn how to master your vocabulary
tutorial.step1Desc: Start by adding English words you want to learn. Our AI will automatically fetch definitions, translations, and example sentences.
tutorial.step2Desc: Use spaced repetition to review words at optimal intervals. Rate how well you remember each word to adjust future review schedules.
tutorial.step3Desc: Monitor your daily learning goals and review your vocabulary archive. Watch your word collection grow over time!
tutorial.step4Desc: Enable notifications to get daily reminders. Consistency is key to building a strong vocabulary foundation.
